quote: Erdős & Szekeres (1935) proved the following generalisation: Theorem—for any positive integer N, any sufficiently large finite set of points in the plane in general position has a subset of N points that form the vertices of a convex polygon.
note: First posed in the 1935 paper 'A combinatorial problem in geometry' in Compositio Mathematica, volume 2, pages 463–470.
